system_overview: This is a minimal model-checking configuration module for the key-value store with snapshot isolation. It extends the base key-value store specification and defines a symmetry set for transaction IDs to reduce the state space during model checking.
actors_and_components: Same as the base key-value store specification: a shared store and concurrent transaction processes. This module adds no new actors but provides a symmetry optimization for model checking.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the base key-value store specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the base key-value store specification.
actions: Inherits all actions from the base key-value store specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the base specification. The model-checking configurations check the type invariant and transaction lifecycle invariant.
model_bounds: Three alternative configurations of varying sizes are provided: (1) Small: two keys, two values, three transaction IDs. (2) Medium: three keys, three values, two transaction IDs with symmetry reduction. (3) Large: three keys, two values, three transaction IDs with symmetry reduction. The symmetry reduction treats all permutations of transaction IDs as equivalent, significantly reducing the state space. The no-value sentinel is defined as a constant.
additional_assumptions: The transaction ID symmetry set enables TLC to exploit the symmetry of transaction identifiers, treating permutations of transaction IDs as equivalent states. This is valid because the specification treats all transactions identically. The module imports TLC-specific operators for the symmetry definition.
